# Geisbauer LFP Accelerated Calendar-Aging Cohort

`LFP_Data.csv` is the LFP subset of *Experimental Calendar Ageing Data for
Lithium-Ion Battery Chemistries*, version 3.

- Authors: Christoph Geisbauer, Markus Woerle, Philip Keil, and Andreas Jossen
- DOI: <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6685365>
- Record: <https://zenodo.org/records/6685365>
- License: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Original ZIP SHA-256:
  `327ab07a89b3eb68ef422817f4bd75f50ab6fed399d458381c3b9f1d984fe155`
- Included CSV SHA-256:
  `4b42216bc87bbb3cfeab18a307da1149b6ca4583898cc359e32c81d219bb03cb`

The file contains 15 individual LFP cells stored at 60 C, with five cells at
each of 20%, 50%, and 100% SOC. Checkups occur at 0, 39, 59, 84, and 120 days.
LifeTwin includes the original 2.7 KB CSV member without measurement changes.

This cohort is used only as an `accelerated_external_stress_check`. Its 120-day
horizon cannot validate long-term calendar life, ordinary-temperature transfer,
Hithium products, storage plants, or 15-25 year forecasts.
